text:
Maya Chen: heads up — coverage sankey panel on the scorecard looks wrong after the runner deploy, lots of missing outgoing edges from variant nodes :eyes:
Devin Patel: I saw that too. counts on the left don't match sample totals in the raw export
Liam O'Connor: screenshot? iirc this started after the sampling refactor that touched variant grouping
Maya Chen: https://redwood.internal/s/abc123 — click 'coverage sankey' then pick model x. sample totals show 48k but sankey only accounts for ~12k
Sara Alvarez: quick check: the runner writes sample metadata with "sample_group" and we aggregate by that. maybe nulls dropped? iirc sankey logic does group_by sample_group then filter where count > 0
Devin Patel: dumping a quick query from the telemetry DB:
```sql
SELECT sample_group, count(*) FROM eval_samples
WHERE model_alias = 'model-x' AND run_id = '2026-03-18-quick'
GROUP BY sample_group;
```
Gives 48k across 6 groups, group "none" has 30k
Maya Chen: sankey code in frontend expects explicit group labels and ignores "none"/null which collapses a big chunk
Liam O'Connor: that explains the visual gap. is that a runner change or sankey rendering defensiveness?
Sara Alvarez: looks like both: runner changed default label from null->"" (empty string) in 2026-03-18 deploy, sankey filter does `if (!label) return` so empty string is falsy and gets dropped
Devin Patel: ugh. minimal fix: treat empty string as valid label. quick patch suggestion:
```diff
- if (!label) return;
+ if (label === null || label === undefined) return;
```
Maya Chen: can we patch in prod? the dashboard customers are noticing coverage holes in scorecards on a few evals
Liam O'Connor: will submit a tiny PR to frontend and add a unit test for empty-string labels. also update runner to use explicit "unknown" label instead of empty string to be safer
eval-bot: CI started for PR #4521 (frontend): eval-ui/sankey-label-guard
ci-bot: CI pipeline reported one flaky test: eval-ui > sankey > renders large group snapshot. rerun queued.
Devin Patel: adding a quick telemetry alert so we catch a sudden drop in sankey_covered_samples / total_samples < 0.8 for 3 min
Sara Alvarez: also want to add a reconciliation job to run nightly comparing raw export counts -> dashboard-covered counts and create a ticket automatically when mismatch > 5%
Maya Chen: thanks team. can we get the PR link once CI passes? i'll coordinate a hotfix deploy and ping CS for affected customers
Liam O'Connor: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4521 — added test and changelog entry
ci-bot: CI passed for PR #4521 — all checks green :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: deploying to canary now, will monitor the scorecard sankey and the new reconciliation job tomorrow morning
Devin Patel: if anyone runs into other missing nodes, check for falsy label filters ("", 0, false) in viz code. ran into 0 once when a numeric id got coalesced to 0
Sara Alvarez: noted. i'll open a follow-up to standardize sample_group to string schema and enforce in runner ingestion
Maya Chen: awesome. :sparkles: closing loop after canary looks stable
